request.topic_description:
Situation: The manager now asks about your practical cooking experience and whether you fit the kitchen's needs. This is the core part of the interview because it decides if your background matches the role. You also need to understand the duties, pay, and when work could begin if they choose you.
Learner: Cook. Partner: Manager.
Not in this scene: introductions, saying your name, naming the job, where you worked, how long you worked there, interview timing.

About the learner, in their own words: Собеседование, я повар, работал в ресторане три года
